notes.notes:

There is a problem with game server management, making it impossible to proceed with the service, so the game itself will be completely reorganized into offline game in the future.
I'm really sorry for the inconvenience caused in using the service, and I plan to make existing play data available even after offline.

notes.title: Sever Maintenece Notice
notes.notes: Sorry for late notice, 50's VM server will start it's Sever Maintenece at after 30 minutes. It will be ended UTC 10:30. I am really sorry about late notice...

notes.title: 50 v1.40 Update!
notes.notes:
Added & Changed feature
-It is no longer have long loading when placing or releasing party members.
-Fixed the problem of abnormally long loading after stage clearing.
-Loading time has now been greatly reduced since synthesis, extraction, and incantation.
-Guest login is now added. Play games without creating an account! The way to switch to a regular account will be added later.
-The next patch will change the general stage and party member experience system and mission as a whole.
-There are many experimental patches, so you may have missed bugs. If you report the error in the discussion tab, I will fix it as soon as possible.

notes.title: Update progress
notes.notes:
Recently, the game has not been updated well. To make an excuse, it is because one super-large content and loading improvement are underway. First of all, it is news of improved loading in compilation. The next patch will improve the loading of the combination, which will take up less time for each member to be removed and inserted. Please understand that it takes time because the client we had built before was very crude. The aforementioned super-large content will be released when it is ready.
[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hNZI1gU-r1okcdp-rxTU3hEUpabnaAN4/view?usp=sharing]Example short video.[/url]

notes.title: Server is stabilized!
notes.notes: I solved problem that make we couldn't log in. Now you can  log in.

notes.title: 50 v1.38 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
- Fixed an error that caused the name to be blank and the progress to stop because the boss could not retrieve information.
- Fixed an error that caused progress to stop because information could not be retrieved.

notes.title: 50 v1.37 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
- We have corrected the price marking error when purchasing the silver box.
- Fixed a bug where floating-point notation did not play in other countries.

notes.title: 50 v1.36 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
- Integrated the synthesis and extraction buttons of the lobby into the member window.
- Improved buff window UI during battle.
- Improved UI of the programming window.
- Improved UI for using experience potions.
- Improved Daily Reward.
- Decreased the price of the revival item.
- Status have been added. You can get 3 status per level and distribute them.
- Preparing a US server. It will open next week or the week after next.

notes.title: 50 v1.35 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
-Increase the probability of gold chest, epics chest, and legendary chest.
-Fixed a bug that could not be played after level 40.

notes.title: 50 v1.24 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
-Improved  Lobby's performance.
-Added level 20~28 stage in elite stages.
-Increased exp reward of early normal stages.
-Changed lobby loading UI.

notes.title: 50 v1.31 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
-You can enter the elite stage starting from level 30.
-You can get experience, rune, experience potions on the elite stage.
-Experience potions can be moved by pressing the top button on the extraction screen.
-Changed level requirement lower. (enchant, extract, heroic dungeon)
-If you clear the normal stage of the previous stage, the next stage will also be opened
-You can now see who has leveled up on the results screen.
-Elite Stage and Experience Potion missions have been added.

notes.title: 50 v1.24 Update!
notes.notes:
Added feature
-Improved Hero panel's performance.
-Now you can use up and down arrows at stage select scene.

notes.title: 50 v1.23 Update!
